typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

percentOpen.description: The {@link Feature} that represents the PERCENT_OPEN sensor instrumented on the Control Valve.

excludeFeatures.description:
Use this field to specify the list of columns in the input data that should be excluded from model training.

If any of the values specified in this list are not columns in the input data, the pipe will ignore them, and
will proceed with training and inference with the remaining features.

processVariable.description: The {@link Feature} that represents the PROCESS_VARIABLE sensor instrumented on the Control Valve.

setpoint.description: The {@link Feature} that represents the SETPOINT sensor instrumented on the Control Valve.

mode.description: The {@link Feature} that represents the MODE sensor instrumented on the Control Valve.

onOff.description: The {@link Feature} that represents the ON_OFF sensor instrumented on the Control Valve.

flowThroughValve.description: The {@link Feature} that represents the FLOW_THROUGH_VALVE sensor instrumented on the Control Valve.

flowThroughValveThreshold.description:
When a regressor is used to generate reconstructions, use this field to specify a threshold value to manually set the
riskScore for rows corresponding to when the Control Valve is closed (the percentOpen is < 5.

For these rows, if the flowThroughValve is > {@link flowThroughValveThreshold}, the riskScore
will be set to {@link highRiskScoreValue} indicating leakage, else it will be set to {@link lowRiskScoreValue}.

highRiskScoreValue.description:
When manually setting the riskScore for rows corresponding to when the Control Valve is closed, use this field to specify
the value of the riskScore when the flowThroughValve is > {@link flowThroughValveThreshold}.
If not specified, the risk score will be set to the maximum absolute residual value in the training data.

lowRiskScoreValue.description:
When manually setting the riskScore for rows corresponding to when the Control Valve is closed, use this field to specify
the value of the riskScore when the flowThroughValve is < {@link flowThroughValveThreshold}.
If not specified, the risk score will be set to 0.

tolerance.description:
When a rule based model is used to generate reconstructions, use this field to compute the risk score to avoid division by 0
errors when the {@link setpoint} is 0.

title:
This is an extension of the {@link ControlValvesModelableBase} type to provide an SME recommended approach for
modeling Control Valves. In this approach, the input data should contain features for the PERCENT_OPEN,
PROCESS_VARIABLE, SETPOINT, MODE and ON_OFF {@link ExpectedSensor}s instrumented on a Control Valve. Then, if the input data
also contains a feature for the FLOW_THROUGH_VALVE {@link ExpectedSensor}, a regressor will be trained to predict the
percentOpen based on the other features.

If the input data does not contain data for the FLOW_THROUGH_VALVE {@link ExpectedSensor}, a rule based approach will be used
where the reconstruction is the SETPOINT, and the residual is the difference between the PROCESS_VARIABLE and SETPOINT.



If the generated reconstructions are computed from the regressor based approach, the riskScore is set to the absolute value
of the residual (difference between the actual and reconstructed values of the percentOpen feature).

However, for rows where the percentOpen is < 5, if the {@link flowThroughValve}
is > {@link flowThroughValveThreshold}, the riskScore is set to {@link highRiskScoreValue}, else to {@link lowRiskScoreValue}.

If the generated reconstructions are computed from the rule based approach, the riskScore is set to
|residual|/reconstruction,which is the absolute percentage difference between the
{@link processVariable} and the {@link setpoint}.



If the generated reconstructions are computed from the regressor based approach, feature contributions are generated using SHAP, and
scaled to sum up to the risk score. Note that in order to generate feature contributions, the
{@link ReliabilityRiskMl.Reconstruction.ControlValvesPipe#regressor} must be a tree based model or a linear model.
However for rows where the percentOpen is < 5, the feature contribution for the flowThroughValve is set to the risk
score, and the feature contributions for the other features are set to 0.

If the generated reconstructions are computed from the rule based approach, feature contribution for the {@link processVariable} is set to
the risk score.
name: ControlValvesModelable
